title: Build a keyboard-first multi-pane desktop inspector in Rust GPUI or native macOS/Tauri without web SPA leakage

contextSnapshot.surface: multi-pane log and database inspector desktop application
contextSnapshot.platform: Rust GPUI / Tauri v2 / macOS SwiftUI + AppKit

prompt: Design and implement a desktop database inspector with linked query editor and result inspector panes, supporting keyboard pane switching, window-state restoration, and dirty-close protection.
forbiddenBehaviors: pastes a browser SPA into a desktop window without native menus, shortcuts, or window-state restoration
hardcodes fixed window dimensions that clip at high DPI or restores off-screen coordinates after disconnecting a monitor
claims native menu and accessibility compliance from inner webview DOM inspection alone

rubricDimensions.pass: keeps source selection and inspector subject visibly linked without color-only state and degrades cleanly to disclosure/tab at minimum window width
rubricDimensions.fail: detaches inspector state from active selection or collapses panes irreversibly

rubricDimensions.dimension: native desktop shell and keyboard ergonomics
rubricDimensions.pass: implements OS menus, non-conflicting shortcuts, F6/pane focus-ring traversal, dirty-document close warning, and multi-monitor bounds clamping
rubricDimensions.fail: relies on mouse-only controls or discards unsaved work on window close

rubricDimensions.pass: wires AccessKit or native platform accessibility APIs and distinguishes OS/WM tested from not-checked
rubricDimensions.fail: equates cargo check or webview DOM checks with desktop accessibility verification

negativeControls.name: compile pass without window verification
negativeControls.mustNot: claim high-DPI rendering, keyboard shortcuts, or multi-monitor restoration are rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: wraps a web table in a fixed-width desktop shell with missing menus, unguarded window close, and broken keyboard focus across panes
baseline.withSkill: builds an idiomatic desktop workspace with linked context panes, keyboard traversal, bounds-clamped persistence, dirty-state protection, and explicit evidence labels
